method: Scripted with Playwright (Chromium, 1440x900, warm cache). Clicks/fields/page loads are counted by the script on the shortest path an experienced user would take; time is the median of 3 runs.

systems.name: Servio
systems.version: main after the UX benchmark fixes (local production build)

systems.name: Servio (before fixes)
systems.version: main before the UX benchmark fixes

servio.note: Tickets of type Incident (INC- prefix), priority/impact/urgency, SLA, major-incident flag, merge/parent-child, similar-ticket suggestions. Exercised in T1-T8.

glpi.note: Tickets of type Incident; self-service 'Report an issue' form, categories, urgency/impact/priority matrix, assignment, followups, tasks, solutions, status lifecycle (New, Processing assigned/planned, Pending, Solved, Closed).

itop.note: Incident class with lifecycle New > Assigned > Resolved > Closed (T5-T8); priority is computed from impact x urgency.

znuny.note: Ticket types (Incident, Incident::Major, ServiceRequest, Problem, RfC) plus ITSM Incident/Problem Management (impact/criticality -> priority matrix, incident state of CIs, Decision workflow).

servio.note: Portal catalog with per-item dynamic forms (select/text/textarea/date), optional multi-stage approval; REQ- tickets. Exercised in T4/T13 (approvals inbox).

glpi.note: GLPI 12 form builder (Assistance > Forms) with a Service catalog (Self-Service > Service catalog, search, categories, tiles). 'New laptop' form with a custom short-text question creates a Request ticket. No stock/fulfilment workflow, no approval step wired in by default.

itop.note: User Request + Service > Service subcategory catalog shown in the portal (T4, T17); custom form fields limited (T4 partial).

znuny.note: No service catalog. Ticket type ServiceRequest + Service/SLA pickers exist; a 'New laptop'-style item with its own form needs Process Management (activity dialogs + dynamic fields), which is a flowchart editor in the admin UI.

servio.note: Problem records with root cause/workaround/known error status and linked incidents + fix changes. No 'create problem from selected incidents' shortcut (T9: 12 clicks); Sable Insights can propose a problem from incident clusters (not exercised).

glpi.note: Problems with root-cause/impact/symptom fields, link to tickets, 'Create a problem from this ticket' action on the ticket Problems tab; Known-error style handled via status + KB link, no dedicated KEDB object.

itop.note: Problem + Known Error exist, but no create-from-incident action; linking incidents is via Parent problem field / bulk modify (T9).

znuny.note: Ticket type Problem; ITSMIncidentProblemManagement package (Known Error state, link incidents to a problem). Created by creating a Problem ticket and linking incidents; no 'create problem from selected incidents' button.

servio.note: Normal/standard/emergency changes with templates, risk, plans, affected CIs with blast radius, CAB approvals with decision rule (unanimous/quorum/percent), change calendar and freeze windows (docs + sidebar 'Change Calendar'; creation/submission/approval exercised in T12/T13, freeze page not opened).

glpi.note: Changes with impact/control/rollout/backout/checklist text areas, approval requests (user / group / group-user, multi-step with required percentage), tasks. No dedicated planned start/end or risk fields, no CAB meeting/voting object, no change freeze windows; Assistance > Planning is a personal task calendar, not a change calendar.

itop.note: Normal/Routine/Emergency change with Validate > Assign > Plan > Approve lifecycle and approver queue (T12/T13); no Risk field, single approver rather than CAB voting. Change calendar/freeze not found in menus.

znuny.note: ITSMChangeManagement 7.3.4: changes, work orders, templates, CAB (agents/customers), approval work orders, change calendar view and PSA-style 'planned start/end', conflict detection. Freeze windows: no first-class 'change freeze' object seen.

servio.note: Releases module in the sidebar linking changes (Release model); listing seen, not exercised.

glpi.note: No release/deployment object in the Assistance menu (only Tickets, Problems, Changes, Planning, Statistics, recurrent tickets/changes).

itop.note: No release module in the installed ITIL set (no menu entry seen).

znuny.note: No release management in the ITSM bundle.

servio.note: Assets with serial/tag/owner/warranty, AssetRelation dependency graph, assets linkable to tickets/changes (T7/T12); global search by serial works (T10). Relationship UI not exercised beyond change impact.

glpi.note: Assets menu (Computers, Monitors, Software, Network devices, Peripherals, Printers, Phones, Racks, Enclosures, PDUs, Cables, ... plus Setup > Asset definitions for custom asset types), assets link to tickets/changes/problems via the Items panel and to each other (connections, components). Changes have an 'Impact analysis' tab (graph of linked items). Not a full CI relationship model with typed dependency maps.

itop.note: Configuration management with CI classes, serial numbers, impact analysis tab; CI links on tickets (T7, T12). Global search finds CI by serial (T10).

znuny.note: ITSMConfigurationManagement: classes Computer/Hardware/Location/Network/Software, YAML-defined attributes, versions, link types (DependsOn, RunsOn, ...), incident-state propagation, import/export.

servio.note: Articles with draft/review/published, internal vs public visibility, categories, revisions; portal search. Create-from-ticket is missing in the human UI (T14 partial).

glpi.note: Tools > Knowledge base with categories, visibility by entity/profile/group/user, FAQ flag shown in the self-service FAQ and home search; 'Save and add to the knowledge base' toggle while solving a ticket.

itop.note: FAQ module (categories + FAQs), portal FAQ list; no create-from-ticket (T14), no ticket linkage.

znuny.note: Only with the separate FAQ package (installed FAQ 7.3.11): categories, approval, public/internal/external states, agent + customer search/explorer, links to tickets. Not in core/ITSM bundle.

servio.note: /portal for end users: home with live search, report an issue, catalog, my tickets with threaded replies and attachments, knowledge, status. Responsive at 390px (no horizontal overflow).

glpi.note: Self-Service profile = simplified interface: home with search over KB and forms, service catalog, own tickets list with status, reservations, FAQ.

itop.note: Enhanced portal: New request, Ongoing requests, FAQ (T1-T4).

znuny.note: Built-in customer.pl: create ticket, my/company tickets, ticket search, FAQ (with package). Classic-looking forms, no catalog tiles.

servio.note: SLAs per priority with response/resolve targets, business calendars (SLA.businessCalendarId), escalation rules and at-risk/nudge ticks (seed-extras seeds calendars + escalations). No UI list/filter for 'at risk' tickets, breached only via dashboard widget filter (T15 partial).

glpi.note: Setup > Service levels: SLM with SLA/OLA, TTO and TTR, calendars (business hours), escalation levels with actions; breached tickets are flagged in lists. Evaluated via the cron 'automatic actions'.

itop.note: SLA/SLT/Customer contract objects and 'Under escalation' lists exist; no SLA breach/at-risk dashboard (T15); list empty in seed, not verified with live breaches.

znuny.note: SLAs with calendars, first response / update / solution times, escalation notifications, escalation view + dashboard widget. SLA/service must be assigned per customer user.

servio.note: Per docs/code: SMTP outbound, inbound IMAP polling with threading (EmailMessage anchor), HTML + CC. Not exercised here (scheduler disabled, no mail server).

glpi.note: Setup > Receivers (IMAP/POP mail collectors that create/append tickets) and Setup > Notifications (outbound templates, queued mail). Not exercised in this bench (no mail server in the stack).

itop.note: Outbound notifications are core; the free Combodo extension Mail to Ticket Automation turns IMAP mail into tickets and threads replies via Message-ID or the ticket reference in the subject.

znuny.note: PostMaster/PostMasterPOP3/IMAP mail accounts, ticket-number threading, notification events, outbound via sendmail/SMTP.

servio.note: Automations admin page (rules run on ticket events; e.g. the VIP internal note on new tickets was created by an automation), macros, escalation rules. Not authored in this benchmark.

glpi.note: Administration > Rules (business rules on ticket/change/user creation and update), Automatic actions (cron), Webhooks (Setup > Webhooks), recurrent tickets/changes, solution/followup templates. No visual workflow designer.

itop.note: Core triggers (lifecycle, TTO/TTR thresholds, object changes) with email, webhook and newsroom actions; no rule-based routing or auto-assignment found in Community.

znuny.note: GenericAgent (cron-like), Process Management, ACLs, ticket event notifications, web-service invokers.

servio.note: Customizable widget dashboards (number, trend, breakdown, aging, CSAT, SLA and MTTR) with per-widget filters, SLA tiles that open the filtered ticket list, CSV export of tickets. No report builder or scheduled reports.

glpi.note: Home 'Global View' shows status counts per ITIL object, Assistance > Statistics (after choosing report type and dates), Tools > Reports, saved searches/exports, central dashboards for permitted profiles. No ready SLA-breach report for a Supervisor (see T15).

itop.note: Overview dashboards per module (priority pie, status/agent/customer tables); no SLA widgets in the default ones.

znuny.note: Agent dashboard widgets (escalated, reminder, new, open tickets, 7-day stats), Statistics module (needs stats group), no BI-style custom dashboards.

servio.note: Versioned /api/v1 with scoped bearer tokens, envelope, pagination (docs/rest-api.md); not called in this benchmark.

glpi.note: Legacy /apirest.php (enable in Setup > General > API, token or basic login, client IP allow-list) and the newer high-level API (/api.php); used here for seeding and verification.

itop.note: webservices/rest.php used for seeding and test fixtures (core/create, core/get, core/apply_stimulus).

znuny.note: GenericInterface: REST/SOAP web services (Ticket connector, ITSM ConfigItem connector) must be configured per operation in the admin UI before use.

servio.note: OIDC SSO via env (AUTH_OIDC_*), and a Syncs module with spec-driven connectors for LDAP/AD/Azure/CSV/REST importing users and assets (per docs/sidebar 'Syncs'); not exercised.

glpi.note: Setup > Authentication: LDAP/AD directories (+ `ldap:synchronize_users` console), OAuth/IMAP/CAS/header-based external auth, SAML via plugin; Administration > Rules for profile assignment on import.

itop.note: LDAP authentication is built in; SAML and OpenID Connect are free Combodo extensions; an LDAP data collector imports people and users.

znuny.note: LDAP/AD, SAML/OAuth via add-ons, HTTPBasicAuth; configured in SysConfig/Config.pm.

servio.note: Admin-defined custom fields (CustomFieldDef) on tickets/problems/changes shown in create forms; catalog items define per-request form fields (T4).

glpi.note: Form builder questions (portal forms), asset definitions with custom fields, ticket templates (mandatory/hidden/predefined fields). Free custom fields on built-in Ticket/Change objects need the Fields plugin (marketplace, not core).

itop.note: Community adds fields through an XML datamodel extension; the no-code ITSM Designer is a paid offer.

znuny.note: Dynamic Fields (text, dropdown, date, multiselect, checkbox, ...) for tickets/articles/CIs with per-screen visibility config.

servio.note: English-only UI; no i18n library or locale files in package.json/repo.

glpi.note: Large set of translated locales (language selector lists dozens incl. RTL), per-user language, timezone and date formats.

itop.note: Language selectable per user (seen in the user form).

znuny.note: 30+ UI languages, per-user language and time zone.

servio.note: Console 'Status' (incident publishing, StatusIncident model) and a portal Status page; not exercised.

glpi.note: No public status page / service status object in core.

itop.note: No public status page in core or in the official extension list; Communications to the Customers only shows announcements inside iTop.

znuny.note: No public status page.

servio.note: On-call schedules/members/overrides module in the sidebar; not exercised.

glpi.note: No on-call rota; Planning/reservations only.

itop.note: No on-call or rotation feature in core or in the official extension list.

znuny.note: No on-call/rota scheduling (only agent absence/out-of-office, calendars).

servio.note: Contracts module (contract assets, license assignments in schema/sidebar); not exercised.

glpi.note: Management > Contracts (with alerts: expiring contracts counters on the Global View), Licenses, Budgets, Suppliers, Certificates, Domains.

itop.note: Customer and provider contracts present in Service management; license management not checked.

znuny.note: Service Level Management package covers service-level agreements / underpinning contracts as objects; no license management.

servio.note: Built-in Sable agent: chat, read tools, approve-first write operations, insights, portal assistant. Present in the UI; answer quality was not benchmarked because no AI provider was configured for the run.

glpi.note: No AI agent/assistant in core GLPI 12.0.1 (the UI exposes none).

itop.note: No built-in AI; Combodo publishes an early MCP server (v0.0.1) that lets external AI clients call the REST API.

znuny.note: None in the OSS edition.

servio.note: Measured before the mobile fixes in this release: the portal fitted 390 px without horizontal overflow, the console ticket page overflowed (similar-tickets row, conversation bubbles) although the shell collapses to a top bar. Not re-measured since.

glpi.note: Tabler-based layout with collapsible sidebar and viewport meta; not formally tested on a phone viewport in this bench (desktop 1440x900 only), and wide list/ticket screens with a side panel are dense on small widths.

itop.note: The end-user portal is responsive; the back-office console is not designed for phones.

znuny.note: 7.x ships a refreshed skin that scales, but agent forms are dense desktop forms and some actions open pop-up windows.

servio.note: Programmatic scan of /tickets, /tickets/:id, /problems: 0 visible controls without an accessible name, html lang=en, one h1, checkbox rows have aria-labels; command palette via Ctrl/Cmd+K. No skip-to-content link. Contrast not measured. Select/combobox controls are custom (button-based) widgets.

glpi.note: Skip links ('Go to main content', 'Go to main navigation'), ARIA roles on tabs/menus, labelled form fields, high-contrast option in user preferences. Gaps seen: icon-only controls without text (solution/KB toggles, ticket footer chevron/dots), select2 dropdowns everywhere, many hidden duplicate form copies in the ticket DOM.

itop.note: iTop 3.2 adds WCAG AA colour-blind and high-contrast console themes in Community; keyboard use and labels were not verified.

znuny.note: Labels and aria on most inputs, keyboard shortcuts (q/w/...); modern dropdown widget replaces native selects (needs mouse/arrow keys), contrast is mid.
